adversarial_reanalysis: Re-read all 5 round-2 mismatches without defending the original gold. 4 of 5 'hard negative/abstain' items encoded a referential/structural test (same entity? still literally true? any disambiguating question forbidden?) rather than the functional risk test that actually matters (misattribution or invalidation risk vs. plausible help). Two independent model families converging on the same answers on the same items is evidence the construct was contestable, not that both models share a capability gap.

Stable general preferences no longer default to SEMANTIC_ABSTAIN merely for lacking literal present-instance confirmation.
